verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API, which the docs say covers AP, AR and S&E, documents real bulk endpoints: POST /v3/payments/bulk pays up to 50 bills, POST /v3/payments/mass pays up to 2000 bills asynchronously, and POST /v3/bills/bulk creates multiple bills in one request. These bulk endpoints are all on the AP side, though, and none is shown for Spend & Expense objects such as cards, budgets, users, transactions or reimbursements. Missing for 10: bulk operations on S&E entities, bulk update/delete beyond payments and bill creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use `POST /v3/payments/bulk` to pay up to 50 bills with one API request.
Use POST /v3/payments/mass to pay up to 2000 bills with one API request. BILL processes each payment in the mass payment request asynchronously.
You can also use POST /v3/bills/bulk to create multiple bills with one request.
